canonical_data: A per-project SQLite database with an FTS5 index under the Git project, plus an optional local LanceDB semantic index
strengths: Wide agent compatibility through MCP, hooks, and native plugins
Local-first SQLite/FTS5 store with an optional semantic index
Git commits and design rationale captured as structured, queryable memory
weaknesses: Repository is about seven months old with a small maintainer team
Broad feature surface (orchestration, teams, locks) adds operational complexity
Behavioral and adoption claims rest on the project's own documentation
why_it_matters: Demonstrates a local-first, protocol-agnostic memory bridge that lets a project's context follow the developer across whichever coding agent they use that day.
